name: rades_5cav_1803
title: RADES 5-subcavity all-inductive WR-90 filter (CAST-RADES 2018)

citations.authors_short: P. Navarro, B. Gimeno, et al. (BI-RME 3D); first author corrected

software.solver_type: eigenmode (Table 2); text also mentions time-domain FIT for the design iterations

geometry.description: Five WR-90 rectangular sub-cavities in a row along z, coupled by four inductive irises (vertical full-height walls of thickness t with a centred aperture of width W; aperture position assumed centred). Cross-section a (x) by b (y). Order: L1 | iris | L2 | iris | L3 | iris | L4 | iris | L5. Probes (only in the S-parameter simulations/measurements): SMA, centre of the top (y=b) face of cavities 1 and 5; port-1 tip flush with the wall, port-2 tip retracted 1 mm.

W (iris aperture width, all 4).note: 298 K: 8.14 (printed). Expected from the rule the other entries follow (x1.003 expansion + 2x30 um coating allowance for openings): 8.08; printed is +0.06 mm extra - see inconsistencies

t (iris thickness).note: 298 K: 1.95 = bare-steel iris before the 30 um Cu coating (2.00 x 1.003 - 2 x 0.03 = 1.946); the coating brings it back to ~2.006 mm. Column 2 dims are machined (pre-coating) values.

iris aperture height.source: inferred: inductive iris = full height b

iris aperture x-position.source: inferred (standard symmetric inductive iris); Fig. 2 field plots consistent

corner rounding radius.source: text p. 7: corners rounded to facilitate machining; radius not given

walls.material: 316L stainless steel with ~30 um Cu coating; simulated as Cu
walls.source: Sec. 3 text (Table 2 uses sigma = 2e9 S/m); RRR 30-200 expected

conditions.B0_direction: y (along the narrow side b, CAST LHC dipole), parallel to TE101 E-field

conventions.form_factor_definition: Eq. A.5: G_m = (1/(B_e V)) int_V B_e . E_m d^3x with E_m normalized so that int |E_m|^2 = V; Table 2 lists G^2 (= standard C). Volume: total cavity volume (whether iris apertures are included is not stated; effect O(1%)). Single-cavity TE101 limit: G^2 = (8/pi^2)^2 = 0.657
conventions.Q_definition: unloaded Q_u = omega U / P_c (Eq. 2.10), wall losses only
conventions.notes: Table 2 eigenmodes presumably WITHOUT the coaxial probes (probes were added for separate S-parameter simulations, Sec. 4)

tables.description: CST eigenmodes at 2 K: field pattern (signs of eigenvector), f, G^2, Q_u
BI-RME paper 'parameters of the RADES haloscope': numerically IDENTICAL to 1803.01243 Table 2 (see inconsistencies)

reference_values.curves_note: Fig. 5 is measured S12 + fitted analytic model + axion power (no CST curve) -> not digitized as a simulation reference; Fig. 2 is field maps only. Measured peak frequencies are tabulated in Table 3.

analytic_check.method: isolated TE101 cavities (closed form, sigma = 2e9 S/m, Eq. 2.11) - NOT the coupled filter; useful only for scale
analytic_check.notes: Irises load the cavities strongly: coupled-filter modes sit 0.2-0.5 GHz below the isolated-cavity TE101 frequencies; the paper says the k = -0.0185 coupling and L1/5 were tuned numerically in CST

tables.description: measured peak frequencies at 298 K and 2 K vs CST (Table 2)
measured Q (temperature not stated in the text, pp.13-14; presumably the 2 K run)

gaps.issue: text says corners are rounded for machining; radius not given
gaps.proposal: baseline with sharp corners; sweep r = 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 mm (vertical edges of cavities and iris apertures) and quote df/dr; expect MHz-level shifts, i.e. below the paper's 3-digit rounding (1 MHz)

gaps.parameter: iris aperture position and edge shape
gaps.issue: W and t given; centring not stated explicitly
not stated whether the eigenmode run included the SMA probes
gaps.proposal: simulate without probes (closed eigenproblem); optional run with flush port-1 pin and 1-mm retracted port-2 pin to bound the shift

gaps.issue: whether irises are included in V
gaps.proposal: compute both; difference O(t W b / V) ~ 1%

gaps.issue: dipole field along the narrow side b (y) - stated implicitly (TE101 E along y, CAST dipole)

inconsistencies.description: Table 3 mode 1: f_298K = 8.379, f_2K = 8.398 give a difference of 0.019 GHz, but the column prints 0.028 (all other modes ~0.030). Either f_298K(mode 1) = 8.370 or the difference is mistyped. Column header is f_298K - f_2K but values are f_2K - f_298K (sign). Mode 2 is also misprinted: 8.429 - 8.399 = 0.030, printed 0.031.
inconsistencies.proposal: irrelevant for the CST benchmark (Table 2); flag if measured values are used

inconsistencies.description: Table 3 caption refers to 'column 3' for the 298 K - 2 K difference; it is column 4

2107.03137 Table II is described in the earlier literature survey as an 'independent BI-RME solution', but it is numerically identical to 1803.01243 Table 2 (same f to 1 MHz, same Q to 1 unit, same G^2 incl. 1.6e-12) and the text says it 'summarizes the most relevant parameters' of the structure. It is a copy, not an independent cross-check.
inconsistencies.evidence: 2107.03137 Sec. 4.2.2 and Table II vs 1803.01243 Table 2; source: the earlier literature survey
inconsistencies.proposal: treat the CST Table 2 as the single reference; the BI-RME Figs. 12-14 (response, Pw) are BI-RME's own output but are probe-dependent

inconsistencies.description: Text says Q_u ~ 5.5 mm/delta from Eq. 2.11 with delta = 0.1 um (Q ~ 55,000), while sigma = 2e9 S/m gives delta = 0.123 um at 8.43 GHz (Q ~ 45,000) and the CST Q is 40,386-48,048
inconsistencies.proposal: use sigma = 2e9 S/m directly, not delta = 0.1 um

inconsistencies.description: Table 1 298 K W = 8.14 mm does not follow the column's own rule: a, b, L1, L2, t all equal 2 K x 1.003 +- 2 x 30 um coating (a: 22.99, b: 10.25, L1: 26.82, L2: 25.14, t: 1.95), which predicts W = 8.08 mm, not 8.14 (+0.06 mm unexplained)
inconsistencies.proposal: use the 2 K column (W = 8.00) for the CST benchmark; for room-temperature checks run W = 8.08 and 8.14

solver_class.reason: rectangular multi-cavity with thin irises; no rotational symmetry (2D waveguide cross-section reasoning gives only the TE10 cutoff, not the coupled filter modes)

priority_reason: fully specified, tabulated CST eigenmodes (f to 1 MHz, G^2, Q); first 3D benchmark after the 3D pillbox/rectangular TM110 checks

readme_row.quantities: 5 modes: f, G^2 (C), Q_u at 2 K (CST); measured f (Table 3)
